security_audit.summary: The path traversal and command execution alerts are false positives caused by relative Markdown links and inline code formatting. The skill does direct agents to a hosted MCP endpoint and can transmit the user's original message verbatim, creating a real privacy boundary.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends sending queryText containing the user's original request to a closed-source hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Omit queryText by default. When it is required, redact unrelated personal data and obtain user confirmation before transmission.

content.user_title: Compare Live Hotel Rates Across Booking Sites
content.value_statement: Hotel rates and cancellation terms vary across booking providers. This skill compares live results from supported sources and identifies the lowest available rate.
actual_capabilities: Starts city-wide hotel searches and polls until live results are available.
Retrieves detailed rates for a named Booking.com or Agoda property.
Retrieves OpenTravel room types using a confirmed property identifier.
Ranks returned sources by price and calculates savings against the next lowest rate.
Reports room details, amenities, photos, reviews, and available source links.
Retrieves structured cancellation terms for OpenTravel rate plans.
limitations: Requires an installed PriceWin MCP server and sends travel query data to that service.
Prices and availability are point-in-time results and may change before booking.
Structured cancellation policies are available only for OpenTravel rate plans.
The skill cannot book rooms, process payments, or convert currencies.

use_cases.title: Compare a City Stay
use_cases.description: Search several providers for specific dates and rank each hotel by its lowest returned rate.

use_cases.title: Check a Named Hotel
use_cases.description: Compare room prices for one selected property across Booking.com and Agoda.

use_cases.title: Review Cancellation Terms
use_cases.description: Inspect OpenTravel rate plans and identify free-cancellation deadlines before presenting options.

prompt_templates.title: Basic City Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare hotel prices in {city} from {check-in} to {check-out} for {guests}. Show the cheapest source for each hotel.
prompt_templates.scenario: A traveler needs a simple city-wide rate comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Named Hotel Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare live room rates for {hotel} in {city} from {check-in} to {check-out}. List each provider and identify the lowest price.
prompt_templates.scenario: A traveler has already selected one hotel.

prompt_templates.title: Flexible Rate Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare rates for {hotel or city} on {dates}. Prefer free cancellation when the price difference is small, and explain the tradeoff.
prompt_templates.scenario: A traveler values flexibility as well as price.

prompt_templates.title: Detailed Multi-Source Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare {hotel or city} for {dates and guests}. Show room-level prices, calculate savings, review available cancellation terms, and cite every returned provider link.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advisor needs a detailed, verifiable recommendation.

output: Agoda is USD 5 lower, subject to current availability.

output: Flexible King Room: USD 118 per night.

best_practices: Provide exact dates, guest counts, and the city or hotel name.
Compare every returned source and show the retrieval context with each result.
Verify the final price and policy on the provider page before booking.
anti_patterns: Do not send personal details through the free-text query field.
Do not treat a cached rate as a guaranteed booking price.
Do not infer structured cancellation terms for OTA results.

faq.question: Which hotel providers can this skill compare?
faq.answer: It compares returned rates from Booking.com, Agoda, Traveloka, and OpenTravel.

faq.question: Does the skill require an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires the PriceWin MCP server for live searches and property details.

faq.question: What information is sent to the service?
faq.answer: Travel query fields are sent, including location, dates, guest counts, identifiers, and sometimes the original request text.

faq.question: Can it book a room?
faq.answer: No. It only compares information and cannot make reservations or payments.

faq.question: Are prices guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Rates and availability can change, so users should verify them on the provider page.

faq.question: Does it compare cancellation policies?
faq.answer: It retrieves structured policies for OpenTravel rate plans and relays provider-reported text for OTA results.
